name: Art Deco evening accessory
summary: The small, hard, bright accessories of evening dress between the wars. They include enamelled and engraved cases, the minaudière, beaded satin pouches and long kid gloves, in geometric forms of black, silver and a jewel colour.

philosophy.core_thesis: An evening accessory is a jewel that holds a powder compact, and its geometry shows modern taste.
design_principles: Cut the form in a clean geometry: a rectangle, a circle or a stepped edge.
Keep the case small, 12 to 20 cm wide, so that the hand holds it as a jewel.
Set a bold contrast: black enamel with silver, or jade green with gold.
Fit the inside with a mirror, a powder compact and a lipstick holder.
Repeat angular motifs in rows: a sunburst, a chevron or a stepped line.
Finish the clasp with a row of small stones or a bar of enamel.
Use a chain or a cord of 20 to 40 cm so that the case is carried in the hand or on the wrist.
Pair the case with long kid gloves and a satin dress.
anti_patterns: A soft slouchy bag with no frame
Fringe and loose beads that hang unevenly

silhouette.shape: A small rigid box or a flat pouch with a geometric outline and a bright clasp.
silhouette.line: A straight top line, a stepped or rounded corner and a bold bar clasp.
silhouette.fit: The case is held in the hand, tucked under the arm or hung from the wrist on a short chain.
silhouette.proportion: Case 12–20 cm wide, 8–12 cm high and 2–4 cm deep; wrist chain 20–40 cm.
rules: Divide the face of the case into bold panels, each a single colour or a single metal.
Set the clasp as the one point of detail, with stones or a contrast bar.
Keep the case flat enough to hold on the hip under a close-fitting dress.
Match the metal of the case to the jewellery of the evening.

fabrics.rule: Use a hard, bright surface for the case: enamel, silver or lizard skin; use satin and beads for the soft pouch.

methods: enamel fired in layers on guilloché
beads sewn on satin in rows
construction.closures: A hinged lid with a push-button catch, or a frame clasp with a bar of stones.
construction.details: A chain or cord handle, an inner mirror, a powder compact and a small stone on the thumb piece.

surface.pattern: Sunbursts, chevrons, stepped lines and bold blocks of colour, set in rows.
surface.gloss: Enamel and polished metal at 80–100 GU; satin at 40–60 GU; lizard skin at 15–25 GU.
surface.wear: A fine piece is kept new: enamel chips and silver tarnishes, and a repaired case loses much of its value.

palette.strategy: High contrast: black with silver or gold, with one jewel colour as an accent.

making.scale: Jewellers made each case by hand for a client; department stores sold a cheaper range in enamelled metal and beaded satin.
making.signs: Sharp edges, an even enamel with no bubbles and a catch that closes with a click.

pieces.form: Box clutch in black enamel with a stone clasp
Minaudière: a rigid metal case with a mirror and a lipstick holder
Satin pouch with rows of angular beads
Evening bag in lizard skin with a metal frame

evidence.title: Minaudière, porte-monnaie et houppette, Paris Musées 20230903122340(1).jpg

emotion.target_response: A sense of modern glamour: the viewer sees a small hard jewel that holds the night's needs.

use_cases: a costume brief for a 1920s or 1930s film
an evening accessory range with a deco look
a museum label for a deco evening bag
avoid_when: the brief is a daytime or work bag
the brief wants a soft, casual look

modifiers.how: Replace the enamel case with a leather frame bag and keep a small, neat form.
Enlarge the case, keep the metal and stones in the clasp and add beads on the whole face.

ornament_level.note: The case runs from a plain enamel box to a face covered in stones.
